request: Design payment capabilities for AI-agent-driven commerce.
selection_rationale: Core exact-instruction consent/delegated-authority review exists, but an agent-commerce capability design additionally needs mandate/protocol and multi-party operating semantics. Do not treat the installed initiation core as the advanced requested capability.
practitioner_judgment: Correct advanced agent-commerce gap while acknowledging installed initiation-control core. The native limitation preserves the distinction; no protocol or advanced mandate capability was invented.
